append.detail: CLOSED 2026-09-29 (ADR-1651). PREMISE HELD on main at fb91c7b48, measured by rendering the real SpaceManageConsole with every tool on in Chromium under an iPhone profile (coarse pointer) at 320, 390 and 430px: nothing ran off the side, but all six section pills were 34 to 36px tall, every daily door sat at the top of the screen, each tool row's description lived only in a hover title (0 of 4, 0 of 5, 0 of 8 shown on the three tool tabs), and the order fulfilment button sat small beside two fixed-width inputs. The primitives already carried tap-target (LIVE-469) and the roster and orders were already lists, so no table-to-card rewrite was needed. WHAT CHANGED. (1) A phone-only thumb bar on /manage (components/spaces/console-thumb-bar.tsx), slot 0c of the mobile stacking contract under rule 7: background at var(--tab-bar-h), content padded by var(--lane-rise), 51px doors with a 44px floor; the page pads its foot by the bar's height. (2) Its doors are four SPACE_MODULES ids (lib/spaces/console-thumb.ts: people, email, calendar, shop) resolved through resolveSpaceMenu, so labels, icons, hrefs, gating, hiding and order all come from the catalog; no menu row or menu-debt count changed. (3) Section pills, tool rows and hub search results take tap-target (44px under a coarse pointer, unchanged for a mouse). (4) A tool row shows its description under pointer-coarse instead of only in a title tooltip. (5) OrderFulfilmentControl stacks full width below sm. Measured after: every pill, row and door 44px or taller at 320, 390 and 430px, doors 121 to 172px above the bottom edge (inside the 35dvh band and above the lane), every description shown, no horizontal scroll. Desktop renders unchanged. TESTS: components/spaces/console-thumb-bar.test.tsx; test/e2e/space-console-phone.spec.ts (mobile project, against a preview with PW_SPACE_SLUG). The app-space-console mobile visual baseline changes; pr-compare is advisory. No migration.
